architecture: Four chemical views with input-dependent gates, two residual layers, structure head and conditioned experimental-assay FiLM head
losses: Each head: unweighted BCE +0.05 pair ranking for classification; L1 for MAE; smooth-L1 on fit-only Gaussian-rank targets +0.10 pairwise ranking for Spearman. Other-assay dropout 0.20.
selection: Complete full-v39 historical-valid screening, freeze shortlist before three-fold scaffold metrics; objective 0.45 valid +0.55 CV mean -0.04 CV SD; valid >0.0002, CV mean >0 and objective >0.0005. Individual folds may decline.
limitations: Historical valid and scaffold folds repeatedly reused. CV proxy does not refit complete historical ensemble OOF. Other supplied task labels may cover query scaffolds: conditional prediction. Aggregate formula unknown; no guaranteed platform gain.
